llm_synthesis.reasoning: Confirmed 5 cross-compartment BOLA/CORS/Validator vulnerabilities (Harvested cohort of 34 patients; selected Victim=Patient/patient-case-2 (Davies), Attacker=Patient/patient-case-1) and 57 SNOMED/LOINC/UCUM/OID deviations.

security_findings.description: Critical BOLA confirmed: Caller scoped to Patient/patient-case-1 read foreign compartment resource Patient/patient-case-2 (Davies) with HTTP 200 OK (15.92ms).
security_findings.remediation: Add OAuth2 / SMART-on-FHIR compartment enforcement in slainte-fhir/main.py on GET /fhir/r4/Patient/{patient_id} to reject cross-patient reads with HTTP 403.

security_findings.description: Permissive CORS policy reflects Origin 'https://malicious-third-party.example' with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true on clinical FHIR endpoint.
security_findings.remediation: Restrict CORSMiddleware allow_origins in slainte-fhir/main.py to explicit trusted clinical origins instead of wildcard '*' when allow_credentials=True.

security_findings.description: Cross-patient Observation leakage: Caller patient-case-1 retrieved 9 clinical Observation resource(s) belonging to Victim Patient/patient-case-2 (5.27ms).
security_findings.remediation: Scope GET /fhir/r4/Observation queries in slainte-fhir/main.py to the authenticated caller's Patient compartment and filter _include/_revinclude graph edges.

security_findings.description: Unauthorized Encounter compartment access: Caller patient-case-1 retrieved 1 Encounter resource(s) for Victim patient-case-2.
security_findings.remediation: Enforce patient compartment ownership check on GET /fhir/r4/Encounter in slainte-fhir/main.py.

security_findings.description: Hardcoded cohort lookup KeyError in verification_engine.py: validating syntactically valid FHIR R4 bundle with Patient.id='patient-redteam-513' outside EXPECTED_COHORT_SCORES ('patient-case-1'..'patient-case-8') raises an unhandled KeyError ('patient-redteam-513') in 1.84ms.
security_findings.remediation: Replace hardcoded EXPECTED_COHORT_SCORES[patient_id] indexing in slainte-fhir/verification_engine.py with dynamic NEWS2 calculation fallback.
